codeReview.summary: The feature meets the core chat-screen contract: the assistant tab renders the modular chat UI, the hook is wired to assistant-gateway, suggestion chips and markdown rendering are present, and the i18n additions cover en/hi/mr. I found only non-blocking follow-ups around retry semantics, theme-token adherence, and missing automated coverage for MessageList-specific behaviors.

issues.description: retryLastMessage() calls back into sendMessage(), and sendMessage() always appends a fresh optimistic user bubble first. When a failed request is retried, the same user turn will be duplicated in the transcript instead of retrying the existing turn.

The inline-code and fenced-code markdown backgrounds use hardcoded RGBA colors instead of theme tokens. The component header explicitly claims there are no hardcoded colors, and AGENTS.md requires M3 tokens for all colors.

The ChatScreen suite fully mocks useAssistant(), so it never exercises MessageList's auto-scroll or keyboard-dismiss behavior. The feature fulfills VAL-UI-022 and VAL-UI-023, but there is still no dedicated automated coverage for those paths.

summary: Pass with minor follow-ups. The core AI chat screen implementation is wired correctly and matches the feature contract overall, but retry semantics, theme-token consistency, and MessageList coverage should be tightened in a follow-up.
